author: KEXP
description:
Doom duo Bell Witch and dark folk elegist Aerial Ruin come together under the collaborative project Stygian Bough. The trio joins us Live on KEXP to share a performance of "King Of The Wood" and more. 

Watch the full in-studio session on our listener-powered YouTube channel.
title: Stygian Bough performs "King Of The Wood" & more Live on KEXP
